title: How To Master AI In 2026
description:
AI in 2026 explained in 60 seconds…

If I had 90 days to master AI from scratch, this is exactly how I’d spend them.

Learn the math, master the fundamentals, understand how models actually work, then stop watching tutorials and start building real projects.

Here’s the roadmap I’d follow today.
